classification: fresh tier-0 persistent-harness evaluation; transport-blocked before scored execution

trajectoryAudit.resourceSpecificInputs: Only the public task question and embedded declarative EvidencePack locations.

timing.timingCaveat: The mediator wall clock overlaps model deliberation and local inspection after grounding.begin, so it is not a pure network-duration measurement.

assessment.interpretation: Grounding retained the public EvidencePack and made bounded mediated requests, but its cumulative wall-clock duration expired before a typed discovery handle existed. The worker stopped without fabricating predicate evidence or resetting budgets, so no attestation, immutable plan, scored query, or release binding exists.
remainingHarnessIssues: Grounding maxDurationMs measures wall time from grounding.begin and therefore charges model deliberation and local inspection against a transport-oriented budget.

Generated callable documentation does not make the typed SPARQL service descriptor sufficiently explicit; the worker passed the service URL as an untyped document source and acquired a 1.2 MB representation before timing out.
The launch prompt initially referenced the skill without embedding its absolute initializer, causing avoidable module guesses and a subsequent global-binding conflict.
assessment.smallestRecommendedChange: Separate cumulative active transport time from a policy-configurable phase lease, and start transport accounting only on mediated requests. Keep a finite wall-clock lease for stale-session cleanup. Also expose the exact typed source descriptor in generated runtime documentation; do not add UniProt-specific logic.
